title: Cary's Songs
description: A cinematic companion playlist for Fearless, by Cary Dortch. RIP Brother.

tracks.title: Soul Stillness (Remix 4)
tracks.caption: Not every battle is meant to be fought with noise. Some victories arrive as stillness. *Soul Stillness* is for the part of you that is tired of performing, proving, and running-yet still refuses to break. A quiet fire. A steady heart. A soul that remembers peace is power. #SoulStillness #InnerPeace #Stillness #Healing #Meditation #SpokenWord #CinematicVibes #Mystical #PeaceIsPower

tracks.title: Frequency of Conscience (Remix 8)
tracks.tags: Black, Gospel, African-American Preacher, Choir, Rap like preaching
tracks.caption: Written by Cary Dortch. RIP brother. https://docs.google.com/document/d/1-y3hOXPupgJl5b22CQiHL_6wpDyTG5Po3NMbXUyzTZs/edit?usp=drivesdk

tracks.title: One Good One (Remix 4)
tracks.caption: A chaotic neon anthem about the ruthless math of friendship-ten fake smiles can't equal one real one, and one bad friend can burn down years of trust. Grit, mercy, betrayal, and truth collide in a rain-soaked carnival of sound. Choose wisely. Love deeply. Guard your soul.

tracks.title: Mother of Light - The Shadow Taught Me (Remix)
tracks.caption: Cinematic spiritual anthem about darkness birthing light, shadow work, healing, divine feminine and masculine union, justice and mercy, Great Spirit, sacred wholeness, and seeing God in both shadow and flame. Mystical choir, tribal stomp-clap, junkyard percussion, prophetic spoken word, 432Hz drone, psychedelic gospel, epic soul, transformational music, light vs dark, inner alchemy, sacred unity, awakening, rebirth.

tracks.title: The Dance of Sun & Shade - Let the Shadows Teach the Flame (Remixed)
tracks.tags: Gritty, cinematic gospel-pop sermon with towering choir harmonies, emotional lead vocals, and spoken-word preaching woven into soaring hooks. Epic drums with deep punchy kicks, dramatic toms, and sub-heavy bass drive a slow-building, anthemic groove. Lush strings and atmospheric synth pads create a mystical, wide-screen soundscape, while crisp modern pop production, vocal stacks, and dynamic rises deliver powerful, tear-jerking impact and spiritual intensity.
tracks.caption: A cinematic spoken-word anthem about the sacred contrast between light and shadow, storm and stillness, loss and grace. "The Dance of Sun & Shade" turns trials into clarity, tears into wisdom, and darkness into the place where inner light learns to rise.

tracks.title: HALLELUJAH OF HELL NO (D&D Collab)
tracks.tags: Black, Gospel, African-American Preacher, Choir, Rap like preaching, sermon, rap
tracks.caption: A cosmic rebellion anthem for anyone who got handed fear in a velvet box and called it holiness. "Hallelujah of Hell No" is funny, defiant, and weirdly liberating - a fire-breathing sermon against shame, control, spiritual branding, and sky-landlord theology. It's part protest revival, part psychedelic jailbreak, part stand-up exorcism for people who would rather grow, breathe, and burn honestly than kneel to polished fiction.

tracks.title: Hush Now - Hush (Remix 9)
tracks.tags: gospel, soul, hip hop gospel (spoken-word/rap preaching)
tracks.caption: A cinematic spoken-word anthem about surrendering the noise, releasing pressure, and finding peace within. "Hush Now, Hush" moves from inner chaos to holy stillness, where silence becomes healing, calm takes charge, and the heart remembers that heaven was never far away.

tracks.title: Pity Is Not Love (D&D Colab)
tracks.caption: Love without respect does not stay love for long. It becomes pity, caretaking, obligation, and quiet condescension. "Pity Is Not Love" is a cinematic gospel-soul spoken-word anthem about dignity, admiration, partnership, and the sacred difference between being cared for and being truly seen.

tracks.title: Mother of Light - One (Remixed)
tracks.tags: black gospel, hip hop, spoken word
tracks.caption: Cinematic spiritual anthem about darkness birthing light, shadow work, healing, divine feminine and masculine union, justice and mercy, Great Spirit, sacred wholeness, and seeing God in both shadow and flame. Mystical choir, tribal stomp-clap, junkyard percussion, prophetic spoken word, 432Hz drone, psychedelic gospel, epic soul, transformational music, light vs dark, inner alchemy, sacred unity, awakening, rebirth.

tracks.title: Fearless Heart (Remix Glow 4)
tracks.caption: A cinematic soul anthem where shadow teaches flame, storms become clarity, and every ending glows into grace.

tracks.title: The Sacred Trust (Remix 5)
tracks.caption: A cinematic spoken-word anthem about stewardship, freedom, beauty, and care. "The Sacred Trust" is a luminous meditation on Earth as a holy inheritance-not something to possess, control, or waste, but something to honor with gentle hands. Emerald mountains, golden sands, rivers, creatures, freedom, grace, and renewal all rise together in one sacred reminder: love protects best when it does not imprison.

tracks.title: The Dance of Sun & Shade (Remix 2)
tracks.tags: Black, Gospel, African-American Preacher, Choir, Rap like preaching, sermon, rap, female voice
tracks.caption: A cinematic spoken-word anthem about the sacred tension between light and shadow, storm and stillness, loss and grace. Through contrast, the soul learns to see: trials refine, darkness defines the flame, wisdom bows in humility, and peace is found not by escaping the night, but by discovering the light that survives within it.

tracks.title: The Gray Between by Roll'n D
tracks.caption: Reality does not live in the cheap comfort of black and white. It lives in the bruise-colored bleed between certainty and shadow. Fearless is not choosing light over dark. It is standing in the storm-soaked middle long enough to see what is actually there. Roll'nD steps into the gray and finds the truth breathing there. #Fearless #TheGrayBetween #RollnD #SpokenWord #Philosophy #Mystical #Cinematic #BeyondBinary #LightAndDarkness

tracks.title: Dark Irony
tracks.tags: dark spoken-word, cinematic, alternative hip hop
tracks.caption: A hollow man builds a hollow home-and calls it strength. But shadows don't stay obedient. They learn. They echo. They become. Now the house breathes back, filled with ghosts he taught to feel nothing. No screams. No tears. Just silence where love should've lived. This is the cost of emotional exile. This is the inheritance of denial. He planted winter… and now even sorrow refuses to grow. By Cary D. https://grok.com/share/bGVnYWN5LWNvcHk_4de8105b-fee3-477d-8e1e-67705fb32d5

tracks.title: The Unguarded Clown-Underestimated By Design
tracks.tags: spoken word, cinematic, dark cabaret, industrial-leaning atmospheric rock
tracks.caption: A dark cinematic spoken-word rap about quiet power, strategy, underestimated intelligence, royal fools, hidden blades, chess moves, secrets, silence, and the clown nobody guards against. The king has the crown. The clown has the plan. Written by Cary Dortch, RIP brother.

tracks.title: Light Irony - One Light Can Heal It All
tracks.tags: spoken-word, cinematic, dark ambient (with tense orchestral tension)
tracks.caption: A father's reckoning becomes a generation's turning point. This is not a song about pretending the damage was small. It is about telling the truth so completely that winter finally breaks. Ruin, regret, memory, silence, and then one brave act of repair. One light. One choice. One honest man refusing to hand the darkness down.

tracks.title: Oreo - The Balance of Creation
tracks.tags: Spoken word. Low frequency male vocals. Cinematic. Epic like a movie trailer.
tracks.caption: A mythic cosmic Oreo commercial where Light and Darkness pause their eternal struggle to discover the perfect balance of cream, cookie, milk, and destiny. Cinematic, funny, dramatic, and snack-powered. "A hilariously epic and exceptionally deep speech about integrating light and dark."

tracks.title: Bartholomew's Blunder (Remix 3)
tracks.tags: cinematic orchestral, film score, children's storytelling / hybrid trailer cues
tracks.caption: A cautionary woodland fable about hunger, temptation, and the trap of seeing only what we want to see. Bartholomew's Blunder turns a glowing honey pot into a warning: not every easy answer is mercy, not every gleam is truth, and discernment may be the thing that saves us.
